name: Radhagobind Commercial Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1981, Radhagobind Commercial 
Ltd is in the business of trading in fabrics and 
ancillary activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RCL deals in fabrication materials, which 
consists of embroidered fancy sarees, H.L. 
fabrics, textile dress materials, and ancillary activities. The company invests its surplus 
money in shares & securities.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
